phase_contract.objective: Create the hotel data ingestion boundary: canonical schema, evidence chain types, ingestion API (parse + validate + normalize), evidence store (persistence with provenance), normalizer, TB diagnostic engine, savings calculator (with methodology enforcement), management report generator, and HTTP ingestion endpoint.
phase_contract.target_output: All Phase 1 files created and type-checked. P0 corrections applied (suppliers.ts + runtime.ts). Ingestion pipeline accepts a real Excel/CSV file, parses it, validates it, normalizes it, persists it with full provenance, and produces a validation report + diagnostic output.
allowed_inputs: New file creation in lib/hotel-data/ and app/api/v1/hotel-data/
TypeScript type checking via tsc or LSP
acceptance_tests: All 8 new files in lib/hotel-data/ exist and are non-empty
p0/runtime.ts no longer contains checkScopeAuthorized workaround
TypeScript type checking passes on new files (no type errors in LSP)
Ingestion pipeline can parse a real Excel/CSV test file
Validation report is produced with correct structure
Evidence store persists and retrieves ingestion events
TB diagnostic produces cost pools + drill-down requests from accounts
Savings calculator correctly classifies CALCULATED_OPPORTUNITY vs SCENARIO
Management report generates actionable output from diagnostic + register
invariants: No legacy contamination of new code paths
p0 intelligence/evidence/security modules are supporting infrastructure, not business MVP
No fabricated data accepted as evidence
No Paperclip as HV product feature
sourceCurrency preserved on every record — no EGP default
Evidence chain: SourceRecord → DerivedFact → Inference → CalculatedOpportunity → Scenario/Hypothesis
baseline - proposed valid ONLY when methodology is evidence-backed
Parser limits (5MB/16-sheet/20K-row) are implementation constraints, not business requirements
required_evidence: All 8 lib/hotel-data/ files created with non-zero size
TypeScript type errors resolved (LSP clean or acceptable)
End-to-end ingestion test: file → parse → validate → normalize → persist → diagnostic
fail_conditions: Ingestion pipeline fails to parse a real test file
Savings calculator produces SCENARIO for evidence-backed methodology
exit_conditions: All Phase 1 files created and non-empty
TypeScript type checking passes (or acceptable LSP errors)
